Complete fixed Native KORG mode input and LED CC tables, plus documented identity/search/native/scene SysEx commands. Normal CC scenes and DAW factory addresses are not inferred from capabilities or parameter offsets.
Includes 97 documented control entries. See coverage limits for 2 source issues or areas still to be added.
Available controls let you look up Note and CC addresses. Lighting effects, encoder behavior and device setup still require the manufacturer instructions.
